summary: The CallForOffers module handles the workflow for creating, updating, accepting, and managing placement request offers in the HSPnet system. It provides a dynamic UI where coordinators can add, edit, delete, copy, and accept student placement offers for specific sites/services/destinations, validating input, enforcing business rules, and updating status and totals in real time.
purpose: To facilitate the call for student placement offers, allowing agencies and coordinators to propose, review, manage, and accept placement requests for students at healthcare sites. The file governs offer creation, modification, acceptance, business rules, and validations on the workflow.

workflows.name: Call for Offers Workflow
steps: Load page and validate user's session and permissions.
Retrieve Placement Request Information (CFOHeader) and display header details.
Display grid of offers for current placement request and calculate totals.
Allow user to add, edit, copy, or delete offers depending on permissions and offer status.
Input fields for Site, Service, Destination, Request Codes, Start/End Dates, Rotations, Number of Students, Comments, and Supervisors.
Validate fields (mandatory, correct formats, range checks, date logic).
Save new or updated offers after validation.
Show/hide Accept Offers panel based on read-only/status and pending offer count.
Accept offers (with reason, notes, and on behalf details if required).
Refresh data and totals after add/update/delete/accept actions.
Print report or refresh view as needed.
Display instructions panel based on user choice.
Handle JavaScript and asynchronous postbacks for dynamic UI behavior.

business_rules: Site, Service, Destination, Supervisors, Start/End Dates, and Number of Students are required.
Start Date must precede End Date and both must fall within timetable range.
If rotations are present, user must select at least one rotation.
Number of Students must be integer between 1 and 99.
Reason must be specified when accepting offers, 'Other' reason requires notes.
Supervisor selection supports 'Add New' entry and must be valid.
Edit/Delete only allowed for un-sent (un-accepted) offers.
'Accept Offers' is only available if there are pending offers and status is not new.
Totals for accepted, cancelled, other, and pending students are dynamically calculated.
Read-only mode disables actions and data entry.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator: Site, Service, Destination, Supervisors, Dates, Number of Students, Reason, Reason Date, Reason Behalf
CompareValidator: Number of Students must be integer
RangeValidator: Number of Students between 1 and 99
RegularExpressionValidator: Date fields must match valid date format
CustomValidator: Rotations selection required, supervisor check for valid entry, Start/End date range within timetable, End Date after Start Date
On behalf text and notes max length (1000 for comments, 200 for notes)
calculations: Totals for Accepted, Cancelled, Other, and Pending Students
DaysFormatted for program year and total years
Rotation date calculations from hidden field and selection
conditions: Show/hide Accept Offers and Reason panel based on permissions, status, and pending offers.
Show/hide instructions based on user session variable.
Enable/disable fields based on read-only mode.
system_behavior: Dynamic UI updates using JavaScript and AJAX (chosen-select, modal popup for details, calendar extenders)
Print and refresh actions update UI and totals
Error/warning messages shown on validation failure
Data binding for dropdowns and lists from supporting entities and session context
dependencies: PlacementRequestOffers CRUD logic (Add, Update, Delete, Copy, Accept)
UserSession variables for permissions, agency/site/service context
Codes for request codes and supervisor salutations
exceptions: Non-numeric or out-of-range student count raises error
Missing or invalid supervisor, site, service, destination, or dates
Notes required if accepting offer with 'Other' reason
Cannot edit/delete sent/accepted offers or if in read-only mode
content_gaps: No detailed error handling for database operations.
Limited information on how request codes map to curriculum.
No explicit workflow for supervisor add/new and related permissions.
Exact instructions and help text not present (referenced as Help topic).
UI styling, localization, and accessibility not detailed.
